Skill Evaluator

Score a SKILL.md before you ship it.
SKILL · RUNS AUTOMATICALLY WHEN IT APPLIES

What it does

Reviews a skill for description quality, triggering accuracy, structure, and skill-vs-inline placement, then writes a versioned eval report.

When to use it

After creating or revising a SKILL.md, to confirm it is production-ready.

How to trigger it

"evaluate this skill"

"score my skill"

"is this skill production-ready"

Requirements

What this skill needs in order to run. Added 2026-08-20.

Skills - None.

Connectors / MCP servers - WebSearch - required for the fact-verification criterion, which is the one place the skill must verify rather than read: anything that could have changed (a law, a rate, a form, a default, a deprecation) is checked against current reality.

Folder access - Read access to the SKILL.md under evaluation and write access to the evaluation output.

KB modules / context files - The SKILL.md being scored.

Repos - None.

If something is missing - No search means the fact-verification criterion cannot be scored, and the skill should say so rather than pass it - a claim marked verified without a check is the SILENT failure here. A clean first evaluation forces a dry-run re-run, because a spotless first pass is more often an inflated one.
